import pytest

def test_daterange_step_year_with_december_start():
    start_day = date(year=2012, month=12, day=25)
    end_day = date(year=2023, month=1, day=1)
    result = list(daterange(start_day, end_day, step=(1, 0, 0), inclusive=False))
    expected = [
        date(2012, 12, 25),
        date(2013, 12, 25),
        date(2014, 12, 25),
        date(2015, 12, 25),
        date(2016, 12, 25),
        date(2017, 12, 25),
        date(2018, 12, 25),
        date(2019, 12, 25),
        date(2020, 12, 25),
        date(2021, 12, 25),
        date(2022, 12, 25),
    ]
    assert result == expected
